title: MAXWELL post-training of ProteinMPNN designs thermostabilizing mutations
summary: MAXWELL calibrates the amino acid probabilities of protein language models to produce mutational stability landscapes. Applied to ProteinMPNN, it outperformed ThermoMPNN and other methods on a curated benchmark of measured stability changes. Of ten single-point mutations designed in DhaA dehalogenase, seven (70%) increased thermal stability, with G171W the largest gain (delta Tm 4.91 C). Preprint; one enzyme and ten designs.
